name: BlissOS
description: BlissOS is Android x86 as a full desktop operating system, running on its own kernel rather than inside a host. It suits a VM with a passed-through GPU, where Android apps get real graphics acceleration and their own machine.

notes.text: The last official x86 release is BlissOS 16 (Android 13) from October 2024. There are no newer builds.
Without a passed-through GPU everything renders in software, which works but is slow. For Android apps on a Linux host, waydroid-vm is the lighter option.
